caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a cat sitting upright on what appears to be a rectangular, closed book. The cat is colored in shades of gray with darker stripes and some brownish shading. Its eyes are white with black pupils, and the nose and inner ears are pinkish. The cat is holding a red object in its right paw and a thin, brown stick-like object in its left paw. The red object appears to extend from its mouth and chest area. The book on which the cat sits is colored white with brown edges representing pages and a darker brown cover. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a small printed or signed name “FRANK MCENTEE” in the lower right part of the drawing.
title: Squeak Toy Kitten
